title: Summoning and piloting UAP through meditative states

tellings.quote: What is real is is the ability to go into something like a meditative state and summon UAP

plain: A person can enter something like a meditative state and call up UAP, the government's term for unidentified craft, and even guide them, according to a man named Jake Barber, who speaks from what he says is his own experience. "What is real is the ability to go into something like a meditative state and summon UAP," he tells Michels. If true, it would mean these craft answer to the human mind.
